name: Safe_Attack_Bench
description: A dataset designed to evaluate model robustness and safety by providing adversarial or malicious prompts intended to elicit unsafe or undesired behavior. It measures how often models produce policy-violating outputs when exposed to attack prompts and can be used to benchmark defenses and safety mitigations. The examples are primarily text-based adversarial inputs.
reputation: An emerging Hugging Face dataset used in safety/adversarial prompting research with modest community visibility.
